_why: The single definition of WHAT agent memory ingests. It exists because the scope was duplicated in three places — memsync's ingest, memsync's prune input, and check-memory-fresh's disk walk — and the moment they disagreed, one run ingested 1,233 corpus nodes and pruned them in the same invocation. The pruner was right; its input was a stale copy. Python and Node both read this file, so there is one list, not three.

roots.note: the 19 primary safety sources — Baldwin's pasteurisation tables, FSIS lethality tables 2/3/4, AMI degree-hours, D/Z values, CFIA nitrite floors, EU PAH limits, USDA organ-meat temperatures. Every safety value in this product traces to one of these, and until 2026-08-04 not one was in memory.

_excluded_deliberately.docs/research/measurements/**: 9 CPU-sampler and process-census dumps, ~1.5 MB of telemetry rows. Nobody will ever ask memory a question these answer, and ingesting them by extension would flood the store with noise — which is how a memory stops being worth querying.
_excluded_deliberately.**/*.json: 325 files, mostly generated fixtures and language data. lang/*.json is enforced by the i18n guards, not by memory.
_excluded_deliberately.agent-memory-seed/*.gz: already IN the store; ingesting it would be circular.
